summary: Polished red Aswan granite: coarse rose-red crystals with grey quartz and black flecks, the stone of Egyptian obelisks, columns and sarcophagi.
_comment: The red granite of Aswan, polished: a coarse granite of rose-to-red potassium feldspar (crystals 1 to 3 cm) with grey quartz, a little white plagioclase and black biotite in ragged flakes that gather in clots. Opaque: a hard polished crystalline stone (granite scatters too little to need the Subsurface master, as Granite_Polished). The maps are generated (L2, gen_granite_aswanred.py; the wish list said L3, but ambientCG's granites are countertop stones with no red or rose one among their tags). The mineral colours and shares are a judgement; the mean linear albedo is (0.310, 0.163, 0.148). A honed or dressed face for unpolished work is this article with roughness_bias raised; a distinct dressed (tooled) relief would be its own article. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1), as Granite_Polished: scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), water spots, gated by the Crevice mask. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Granite_AswanRed_Clean_Base_s1_v01

sources.why: Mineral colours (rose-red feldspar, grey quartz, white plagioclase, black biotite), their shares (about 55, 25, 7 and 13 percent) and crystal sizes from Aswan red granite as quarried and polished; mean linear albedo (0.310, 0.163, 0.148); mean roughness 0.12 for a polished face; specular_ior 1.54, that of quartz, as on Granite_Polished. Physically Based has no granite entry. meters_per_tile 1.0 is the s1 option's length; the generator makes the tile at that size.
